Name: buff stacking
Author: xianyadan0608
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]Describe the main purpose of your mod[/color]
This mod enables other foods to also have their uses, and at the same time the benefits of the same food will not be cumulative, thus ensuring the game balance .This module was written by DeepSeekHarness. It is not clear whether it supports foods and buffs other than the original ones.

Manifest.Name: Food Buff Stacking
Manifest.Description: Let buffs from different foods/drinks stack (vanilla only keeps one food and one drink buff), while eating the same food again only refreshes its timer.
